scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M explicit tiled-WMMA SWA diagnostics on gfx1151

design.qk: four wave32 BF16 16x16x16 WMMA waves across K64
design.pv: cooperative FP32 online-softmax/PV with one K/V stage shared across adjacent queries
design.ring_correctness: mixed current/cached source repair in M16; explicit source-qualified qrow4 fallback after the pre-wrap region in M8
design.lds_reuse_followup: M8 overwrote the K tile with V after QK/softmax to reduce simultaneous LDS residency

correctness.primitive: 16-row and 15-row 500..515 wrap/eviction outputs passed against source-qualified qrow4 at rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-6
correctness.prewrap: 128-row 384..511 tiled output plus 512..513 fallback passed against production
correctness.allocator_reuse_landmine: masked invalid cache payload can contain BF16 NaN; branch-free versions must sanitize logically uninitialized payload before zero-weight PV
correctness.full_quality_gate_reason: both correct candidates failed the pp512 performance gate

pp512.protocol: one resident owner; warm both modes; three counterbalanced synchronized pairs; matrix512/attention128

decision: Reject and remove both tiled-WMMA routes. M16 K/V reuse is outweighed by 50.7 KiB LDS and maximum-register pressure. M8 lowers LDS to 22.0 KiB but doubles workgroups, wastes half of each 16-row WMMA query tile, and remains slower. Source-qualified scalar qrow4 stays production.
